module_title: J&K, Uttarakhand Passes, and Peninsular Peaks
introduction: Examiners love testing the strategically vital passes of J&K and Ladakh, the passes of Uttarakhand used for pilgrimages, and the highest peaks of Central and South India.

core_concepts.title: Vital Passes of J&K and Ladakh
core_concepts.description:
1. **Zoji La:** Connects **Srinagar to Kargil and Leh**. 
2. **Banihal Pass:** Located in the Pir Panjal Range. It connects Jammu to Srinagar. The famous **'Jawahar Tunnel'** passes through it. 
3. **Burzil Pass:** Connects Srinagar to Gilgit (POK).

core_concepts.title: Passes of Uttarakhand (Kailash Route)
core_concepts.description:
1. **Lipulekh Pass:** Connects Uttarakhand to Tibet. It is famously used by pilgrims for the **Kailash Mansarovar Yatra**. (It lies at the tri-junction of India, Nepal, and China). 
2. **Mana Pass and Niti Pass:** Both connect Uttarakhand to Tibet.

core_concepts.title: Peaks of Peninsular (South/Central) India
core_concepts.description:
1. **Anamudi:** **Kerala** (Anamalai Hills). It is the **highest peak in South India** and the Western Ghats. 
2. **Guru Shikhar:** **Rajasthan** (Mount Abu). It is the highest peak of the Aravalli Range (India's oldest mountain range). 
3. **Dhupgarh:** **Madhya Pradesh** (Pachmarhi). It is the highest point of the Satpura Range.

important_entities.name: Doddabetta
important_entities.significance: Doddabetta (Tamil Nadu) is the highest mountain in the Nilgiri Hills and the second highest peak in South India after Anamudi.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation:
Exam Trap: 
- If asked for the 'Highest peak of South India / Western Ghats', the answer is **Anamudi**. 
- If asked for the 'Highest peak of the Nilgiri Hills', the answer is **Doddabetta**.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Ma = Mana, Li = Lipulekh, Ni = Niti. These are the three vital passes of Uttarakhand.

exam_strategy_tips: A favorite State PCS/UPSC question: 'The Jawahar Tunnel was constructed under which pass?' Answer: Banihal Pass (J&K).
